text: Please can someone ring me. My granddaughter Rosie is 8 and her temperature is 39.8. I can't get her to wake up properly. I've been shaking her shoulder and saying her name and she just sort of groans and goes floppy again, she's not answering me like she normally would. She was fine at teatime. Her neck isn't stiff, I asked her to look down at her feet and she did eventually, and she's been to the toilet for a wee twice this evening so that seems normal. But she's not right. I've never seen her like this. Her mum and dad are away and I'm frightened I'm doing the wrong thing.
